But they say "next month November". So maybe they want to travel in November, but the phrase "two days after close of the 14th day in the year 2026" might refer to the date of booking? We do have access token 'abc123xyz'. So we can call get_credit_card_balance with access_token: abc123xyz, card_id: AMEX123456789. That returns balance. Then we can compare with cost. Then we can inform user if enough. So we need to call get_nearest_airport_by_city twice, then get_flight_cost, then get_credit_card_balance. Then produce response.
